skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic logistics and supply chain management theories in practical research and analysis.
Develop and execute a practical project report.
Manage customer service operations in a business context.
Manage inventory operations in a business context.
Manage transportation operations in a business context.
Manage risks in supply chain operations.
Extract and analyze data for logistics and supply chain management.
Demonstrate self-reliance and personal responsibility in independent work.
Express and defend personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches.
